title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
native: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ2
synopsis:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you..

When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

episodes.title: Last Chance for a Slow Dance
episodes.description: A former edgerunner slipping into cyberpsychosis and a lonely survivor with a fractured past start their stories at opposite ends of Night City.

episodes.title: Give Me Another Day
episodes.description: A desperate call drags Weak back into danger to save a rebellious teen. As D bonds with a young cinephile, painful flashbacks fuel his thirst for revenge.
Weak tries to rescue Talia from a dangerous surgery, but the confrontation ends in disaster. D and Roman discover a chaotic chip that sparks mayhem.

episodes.title: Someone That I Used to Know
episodes.description: Armed with abilities he doesn't fully understand, D uses Capri's power to infiltrate an Arasaka research facility. Talia and Weak find common ground.

episodes.title: Fades (Pass the Distance)
episodes.description: An impulsive act sends Talia into a terrifying spiral. D's obsession with revenge reaches an unsettling new level of violence.

episodes.title: Everything Hate
episodes.description: D becomes an anti-corporate vigilante and asks Roman to film his every move. Weak looks into rumors of tech that can transfer digitized consciousness.

episodes.title: To the Depths with You
episodes.description: Talia's condition takes a startling turn under Capri's watch. D reconnects with an old friend. Weak and Avida chase a miracle cure.

episodes.title: Serce
episodes.description: A riot ignites on the streets as D digs deeper into Project Capricorn's dark past. With time running out, Avida and Weak fight for Talia's future.

episodes.title: Strictly Reserved for You
episodes.description: Omi and D go off the grid, and Kiril takes Talia into custody. Kyoko pushes Project Capricorn forward with frightening results.

episodes.title: Then Everyone Went Home
episodes.description: A chilling transformation turns the city into a war zone, erupting in an explosive confrontation.
